name: Undermere
descriptionSeed: A dwarven kingdom around an underground lake in the caverns beside the Descent. It trades with the Abyssal Choir above it, and keeps its doors locked from both sides.
encounterFlavor: lake-boatmen, cavern-farmers, and traders from the Descent who are watched the whole time they are here
axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder (SNG-180).
worldPosNote: SNG-670: placed on the world's own cavern (Erik 2026-10-04: "they live in pockets across the world, in the typical places of their kind"). Below ground: depth -1.
appearance: A black lake under a cavern roof, stone quays and lamplit boats, a city built in tiers around the water, and a great door at the top of the stair with a lock on each face.
_sng670: A pocket: a centre with its own ground, the way a foothill is. Its people are not a tradition; its ruling power and leader come in pass 2.
